Package io.github.janglada.orkit.cutting

package io.github.janglada.orkit.cutting
Cutting-stock solver: 1D rolls, and 2D sheets with free or guillotine layouts.

Provides a fluent DSL for cutting demanded pieces (each with a length and quantity) from stock rolls/sheets of declared dimensions, minimizing total trim waste, the number of rolls or sheets consumed, or the total stock cost. Every piece is required unless dropping is allowed.

Dimension selection. A model is 2D when at least one StockConfig or PieceConfig declares a .width(...) (and then every stock and piece must declare one); otherwise the model is 1D. In 2D, Goals.minimizeWaste() minimizes total area consumed; Goals.minimizeStockUsed() and Goals.minimizeTotalCost() work the same in 1D and 2D.

Models. 1D counts how many pieces of each type go on each roll, so its size grows with the number of piece types, not pieces; offsets are assigned after the solve. 2D places one rectangle per piece instance under NoOverlap2D, with optional 90-degree rotation. CuttingBuilder.guillotine(boolean) restricts 2D layouts to two-stage shelves, which edge-to-edge cuts can always produce; free-form multi-stage guillotine patterns are not modeled. CuttingBuilder.kerf(long) reserves the blade width between pieces.

Entry point: Optimize.cuttingStock().
